Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment primarily uses XL-MS (Cross-linking Mass Spectrometry) with EDC and BS3 reagents. While the PRIDE metadata mentions 'No PTMs', the methods describe specific cross-linking chemistry and the use of pLink for identification. The 'mod_tpp' hint is used as a proxy for structural/complex proteomics (cross-linking) in the absence of a dedicated XL-MS modifier in the provided list, though it is technically a different method. The HDX-MS mentioned in the text is a separate analysis from the PRIDE dataset PXD031827.

scope: All dephosphorylated proteins were purified according to the following protocol.
The protein was cleaved off the beads in Buffer A with 0.7 μM of 3 C protease
Intact protein samples were diluted in H2O and up to 100 ng protein were loaded on an XBridge Protein BEH C4 column
Crosslinking of PDK1SKD-PIF S241A with the zero-length crosslinker EDC was performed
Crosslinking of PDK1LKD S241A with the homobifunctional bis(sulfosuccinimidyl)suberate (BS3) crosslinker was performed
Gel bands were excised, cut up, and destained with acetonitrile (ACN) and 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (ABC).
Proteins were digested with trypsin (Promega) in 50 mM ABC overnight at 37 °C.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis (intact MS, XL-MS, and HDX-MS) was performed on recombinant PDK1 constructs (PDK1SKD, PDK1LKD, PDK1FL, etc.) that were expressed in Sf9 or E. coli cells and purified via GST-tag/affinity chromatography.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study primarily uses recombinant protein variants (mutants) and lipid-mediated stimulation to investigate PDK1 activation. The MS data includes intact mass, XL-MS, and HDX-MS. PIP3 is mapped to immune receptor ligand stimulation as it is a phosphoinositide signaling molecule, though it is a lipid rather than a protein ligand.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The dataset contains two distinct specialized proteomics modalities: XL-MS (using EDC and BS3) and HDX-MS. Standard bottom-up pipelines will not suffice for the cross-link identification (requiring pLink or similar) or the HDX centroid analysis.
